name: Charged Strike
description: Channel energy for a devastating strike dealing 2x damage.

name: Protective Shield
description: Create a temporary shield that blocks incoming damage for 3 seconds.

name: Rapid Dash
description: Dash forward at extreme speed, dealing damage to enemies in your path.

name: Ground Slam
description: Slam the ground, dealing massive area damage and knocking back enemies.

name: Team Recovery
description: Heal all nearby allies for 20 health points.

name: Evasive Burst
description: Become briefly invulnerable and teleport a short distance.
